note: wake on/off fails without Instabox, contradicting the docs. Finder behaviour and wake errors not-walkable.

findings.criterion: mounts wake and mounts service status need Instabox
findings.description: Run `mounts wake coordinator off` and `mounts service status coordinator` with no Instabox installed.
findings.expected: Docs say changing wake 'does not call Instabox' and only updates local metadata; a status check is read-only.
findings.actual: Both fail with "Could not find an executable Instabox CLI in PATH or ~/.local/bin." A user cannot turn wake off or check the service without Instabox. Copy contradicts docs/cli.
findings.suggested_fix: Make wake and status work offline, or fix the docs sentence.
